description: Lightweight tier — lowest cost, but max stays review-capable: glm-5.3-flash explores on flash (kill-line value king at $0.075/$0.25), qwen3.8-flash on standard, qwen3.7-plus codes on pro (newest Qwen tier above flash), deepseek-v4-pro judges on max (strong reasoning reviewer at $0.66/$1.98); vision goes to qwen3.8-flash. qwen3.6-plus is dropped — qwen3.8-flash is newer, cheaper and vision-capable. Requires OPENCODE_API_KEY environment variable (OpenCode Zen).
